items: AI helps restaurants most where there is high transaction volume, repetitive work, lots of data or labor-heavy workflows, such as guest communication, ordering, forecasting and inventory.
Deloitte's survey of restaurant executives found that picking the right use cases and managing risk are the biggest challenges, and most brands feel underprepared.
For most operators, adopting proven AI software from specialized vendors is the most practical start; building in-house suits large groups with strong technical teams.
Momos covers guest experience with Alfie, which drafts on-brand review replies in a Unified Inbox, and Rockie, which surfaces sentiment trends and ranks locations.
